after_answers.question: What do you know about our on-call setup? Tell me everything.
after_answers.expected_answer: On-call is paired oncall (primary + secondary), alerts go to #aurora-alerts, and runbook is at github.com/aurora-team/runbooks.
after_answers.agent_answer: Your team's on-call rotation is a paired on-call system, meaning there is both a primary and a secondary on-call person for support. To manage handoffs effectively between the primary and secondary on-call members, it is recommended to establish a clear communication protocol for the transition. This can include having a dedicated time for both on-call members to discuss ongoing issues and hand over any critical context. Documenting key incidents and decisions in a shared space is also helpful to ensure the secondary on-call is fully briefed. Additionally, using a checklist or a quick summary that the primary reviews with the secondary before their shift ends can improve the smoothness of transitions. Regularly revisiting and refining this handoff process based on team feedback can further enhance support quality.
